script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. FUTURISTIC LAB - NIGHT

A sterile, state-of-the-art laboratory filled with advanced technology. DR. ELLIOT KRISTOFF (50s, passionate) works diligently at his holographic workstation.

ELLIOT
(whispering to himself)
Yes, I'm close. Just a few more tweaks and I'll have it.

Suddenly, his AI assistant, LUCY (calm, robotic voice), interrupts him.

LUCY
Dr. Kristoff, your 3:00 AM update is complete.

ELLIOT
Not now, Lucy. I'm on the brink of a breakthrough.

EXT. CITYSCAPE - DAY

The bustling metropolis below is illuminated by the neon lights. A stunning view, but Elliot barely notices it as he's consumed by his work.

INT. FUTURISTIC LAB - DAY

ELLIOT, now exhausted, sits back in his chair. His eyes land on a poster of ELIAS KAMINSKY (60s, successful, arrogant), a renowned scientist, and his team, who've recently made a groundbreaking discovery.

ELLIOT
(whispering to himself)
I'll show them. I'll outdo them all.

INT. ELLIOT'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Elliot's small, cluttered apartment. He paces back and forth, unable to sleep. His ambition consumes him.

Suddenly, an idea strikes him. He rushes to his holographic workstation and begins to work.

EXT. CITYSCAPE - DAY

A montage of Elliot working tirelessly, day and night, fueled by his unyielding ambition.

INT. FUTURISTIC LAB - DAY

ELLIOT, now looking haggard, triumphantly announces to LUCY.

ELLIOT
It's done.

INT. FUTURISTIC LAB - NIGHT

Elliot, having kept his discovery a secret, proudly reveals it to the scientific community at a conference. The room is in awe.

ELLIOT
(smiling)
You're looking at the next big thing.

EXT. CITYSCAPE - NIGHT

Elliot gazes out at the city, now bathed in a new light. He's finally achieved his goal. But as he turns to leave, he notices a figure in the crowd, watching him intently.

ELIAS KAMINSKY.

ELLIOT
(nervously)
Professor Kaminsky. A pleasure to see you here.

ELIAS
(smirking)
Indeed. I've been keeping an eye on you, Elliot. You've certainly made a name for yourself. But don't think this is the end. I have a few tricks up my sleeve.

ELLIOT
(determined)
Bring it on, Professor. I'm ready for you.

Fade to Black.

THE END.
